name: 歌单清理
description: 一键清理低歌曲数歌单：可设置阈值，自动删除歌曲数量低于该值的歌单。支持每日定时自动清理和手动触发。
author: MusicFlow

configSchema.label: 最少歌曲数
configSchema.help: 歌单歌曲数量小于或等于此值时会被清理删除。例如输入 5 会删除所有歌曲数 ≤ 5 的歌单。

configSchema.label: 跳过平台同步歌单
configSchema.help: 开启后，会跳过由平台插件（如 go-music-dl）同步来的歌单，只清理本地生成的歌单。

configSchema.label: 跳过推荐歌单
configSchema.help: 开启后，会跳过每日推荐、本地推荐等系统推荐歌单，只清理其他歌单。

en.name: Playlist Cleaner
en.description: Clean up low-song-count playlists in one click: set a threshold and it automatically deletes playlists whose song count falls below it. Supports daily scheduled auto-cleanup and manual triggering.

minSongs.label: Min song count
minSongs.help: Playlists whose song count is less than or equal to this value are cleaned up/deleted. For example, entering 5 deletes every playlist with ≤ 5 songs.

skipSourcePlaylists.label: Skip platform-synced playlists
skipSourcePlaylists.help: When on, playlists synced by platform plugins (such as go-music-dl) are skipped and only locally generated playlists are cleaned.

skipRecommendPlaylists.label: Skip recommended playlists
skipRecommendPlaylists.help: When on, system recommendation playlists such as daily and local recommendations are skipped; only other playlists are cleaned.
